project_title: Circuit - Full Stack Application Architecture Simulator & Problem Mapper
design_concept: Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Electronics Studio meets C4 Architecture Visualizer. Dark mode obsidian substrates, glowing copper traces, chip IC node housings, active signal animations, and fault detection 'X' indicators.

key_components.name: Header & Mode Switcher
key_components.description: Sticky top bar with Circuit branding, system telemetry badge, real-time live monitoring toggle, and main navigation tabs (Analyzer, Builder, Live Monitor, History).

key_components.name: Code / Zip / Repo Analyzer Onboarding
key_components.description: Upload panel supporting .zip code upload or GitHub URL paste with live parsing animation (Scanning AST, Detecting Frontend, Backend, DB, LLM Agents).

key_components.name: Interactive PCB Circuit Board Canvas (Node Graph)
key_components.description: Interactive visual canvas where node blocks (Frontend, Backend, DB, Auth, Vector DB, LLM Agents) are connected by copper wire traces with active glowing pulses.

key_components.name: Drill-Down C4 Architecture Inspector
key_components.description: Clicking any top-level component triggers a smooth drill-down view revealing nested subcomponents, internal function pipelines, API endpoints, and database tables connected with sub-wires.

key_components.name: Fault & Problem Marker Overlay ('X' Indicators)
key_components.description: Red pulsing 'X' markers on broken nodes or disrupted wire traces, accompanied by a Problem Resolution Panel detailing root cause, logs, and recommended fix.

key_components.name: Real-Time Telemetry & Interval Monitor Panel
key_components.description: Live monitoring toolbar with configurable refresh intervals (2s, 5s, 30s), active signal heartbeats, latency graphs, and live packet stream simulation.

key_components.name: Chatbot Onboarding Wizard for Circuit Builder
key_components.description: Interactive step-by-step AI wizard asking prompt questions (App type, Frontend framework, Backend runtime, Database, AI capabilities) before populating the canvas.

key_components.name: Drag-and-Drop Circuit Builder Canvas & Component Palette
key_components.description: Side palette with draggable full-stack components (React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenAI, Pinecone) that users can drop onto the PCB canvas and link with wiring tools.

key_components.name: Export & Code Generation Modal
key_components.description: Exports the visually built or analyzed circuit into Docker Compose files, Terraform scripts, C4 diagram JSON, or boilerplate full-stack code.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, canvas nodes, wire connectors, tabs, modals) MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='circuit-upload-btn', data-testid='node-frontend-card', data-testid='fault-marker-db-connection').
testing_and_accessibility.color_contrast: High contrast signals (Emerald #10B981, Cyan #06B6D4, Red #EF4444) on dark slate substrate (#0F172A) with clear readable font styling.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js and .jsx files) as specified by the repository environment. Do not use TypeScript syntax.
Style the application as a dark electronic circuit board studio. Use dark slate backgrounds (#070A0F, #0F172A), grid dots, metallic borders, glowing SVG wire traces, and IC chip node cards.

Implement the full workflow: Code Analysis (upload ZIP / paste URL), Visual PCB Circuit Diagram with animated wires, C4 Drill-Down view into subcomponents, Fault Detection with red 'X' markers and diagnosis panel, Live Interval Monitoring, Chatbot Onboarding Wizard, Drag-and-Drop Circuit Builder, and Export options.
Ensure all headers, dialogs, drawers, and popovers use explicit solid/semi-opaque dark glass backgrounds with backdrop-blur, NEVER fully transparent backgrounds.
Attach data-testid attributes to all interactive and state-displaying components for end-to-end testing verification.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop_rule: Avoid plain generic white or grey card layouts. Make every card feel like an Integrated Circuit (IC) chip with pin leads, silkscreen labels, status LED dots, and copper track connectors.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.navigation_rule: Always render a visible navigation header with brand logo, telemetry indicators, view mode tabs, and primary actions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_state_rule: Always explicitly define hover text colors alongside background hover states to maintain readable contrast.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_header_overlay: DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for navigation headers or dropdown overlays.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_notifications: Use sonner toast component for user feedback when analyzing code, connecting nodes, detecting faults, or exporting projects.
